source.title: Open Problems Related to Palindrome Recognition: Are There Open Problems Related to Palindrome Recognition?

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL for document id 6665187. Direct access to https://zbmath.org/6665187 was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge/403 in shell fetching, and later shell network lookups failed for zbMATH, API, DOI, and JALC hosts.

Bounded exact-work recovery identified the same-work title and DOI 10.25596/jalc-2015-005 through resolver/search metadata and DBLP/JALC records. The JALC candidate https://jalc.de/issues/2015/issue_20_1/abs-005.pdf contains only the title, abstract, keywords, and opening definition page rather than the full article problem statements.

No readable full-text primary source artifact was recovered. JALC full text appeared restricted or unavailable without account access, zbMATH was usable only as a resolver, and ResearchGate/search-snippet candidates were rejected because they were not confirmable as an exact-work readable primary source and could not be fetched as stable full text.

Source adequacy gate failed: extracting questions from the title, abstract, resolver metadata, search snippets, or a non-exact related work would violate the no-new-facts and evidence coverage requirements.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath_6665187.json and outputs/latest.json.
